$comment: BIRD anomaly vocabulary (lib/dispatch/bird.py). Starter set from the 2026-10-14 discovery findings against bonsai (Ollama 0.33.2) plus the standard link-layer failures.

data.label: Request timed out
data.description: No reply within the deadline. Not resent: a request that times out has spent the time it had, and a resend would start with none (AIP-194 retries DEADLINE_EXCEEDED only with a fresh deadline). Raise the task timeout or narrow the task.

data.label: Endpoint unreachable
data.description: Connection refused, reset, or name not resolved. A workstation syndicate may be asleep or its model service down.

data.label: Rate limited
data.description: HTTP 429. Resend after the server's Retry-After, or capped exponential backoff with full jitter.

data.label: Service unavailable
data.description: HTTP 502, 503, or 504 from the endpoint or a proxy in front of it (tailscale serve).

data.label: HTTP error
data.description: Any other HTTP error status. Not resent: the same request would fail the same way.

data.label: Malformed reply body
data.description: The reply is not JSON, or lacks the fields the transport defines.

data.label: Empty reply
data.description: A complete reply with neither text nor tool calls.

data.label: Output cut at the limit
data.description: The model stopped at its output-token limit (finish reason length / max_tokens): HTTP 200 with a partial answer. Observed on bonsai 2026-10-14.

data.label: Malformed tool arguments
data.description: A tool call whose arguments are not a JSON object. Returned to the model as a refused call so it can correct itself (MCP isError).

data.label: Prompt exceeds the context window
data.description: The endpoint refused a prompt larger than its window. Ollama does this only with truncate:false; by default it drops the oldest messages and answers 200 (observed on bonsai: 3040 tokens sent, 26 evaluated).

data.label: Prompt truncation suspected
data.description: The endpoint reports far fewer prompt tokens than were sent (under 40% of a characters/4 estimate), the signature of silent truncation on endpoints that cannot be told to refuse.

data.label: Context running low
data.description: The harness told the model to stop calling functions and answer, because the window was nearly full.

data.label: Known-answer mismatch
data.description: The answer failed the task's known-answer check; the task fails before payroll.

data.label: Policy refusal
data.description: The model declined the composed prompt (usage-policy refusal); attributed to the assigned agent's conduct.
